facts.fact: La Nation reports on 2026-08-26 that the Directorate-General of the Budget's roadmap for Benin's first Open Government Partnership national action plan, co-created with civil society, citizens and the private sector, scheduled consultations in 23 communes (29 June-6 July 2026, with local councillors, disabled people's associations, notables, farmers' and artisans' associations and private sector) and in the twelve departments (10-21 August 2026), and that one of its four axes is access to information and digital governance for inclusion and digital rights; the article says the consultations were 'planned' and the commitments are not yet written.
